_comment: Records live in the plugins; these rules re-apply them at game start if another mod overwrote them. Form refs are 'Plugin.esp|HEXID' (local id).

weapon_keyword._comment: silver weapons hurt undead: WeapMaterialSilver is what SilverPerk checks
Dawnguard weapons are silver (same rule as Dawnguard Weapons Are Silver)

armor_warmth._comment: vanilla Survival default for armor that lost it (Requiem and many mods): heavy/light armor warm, poor clothing cold
